[[General Morgahn|Morgahn]]'s main base of operations.}} The [[Fortress of Jahai]], or '''Jahaidara''', is in northern [[Kourna]], on the edge of [[Jahai Bluffs]] and at the base of the [[Grand Cataract of Jahai]]. The Fortress of Jahai is located over the Elon river, bordering [[Vabbi]]. The doors to the fortress on either side are closed preventing access to and from Vabbi. The fortress was built over the location of the [[Battle of Jahai]], where [[Palawa Joko]] and his forces were defeated by [[Turai Ossa]]'s troops. ==Notes== {{gw2w}} * The fortress is located partially in Jahai Bluffs and [[Yatendi Canyons]]. * Past the closed doors in Yatendi Canyons, one can see a [[portal]]. * Fortress of Jahai is one of three landmarks denoted on the [[Elona]] [[World Map]]. {{Landmarks in Kourna}} {{Landmarks in Vabbi}} [[Category:Vabbi locations]] [[Category:Wayfarer's Reverie landmarks]]
